title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
shortDescription: Independent mercenary Raven pilots modular armored mecha on ruined frontier planet Rubicon 3 fighting over Coral.
historicalSignificance: FromSoftware's triumphant return to mecha combat, celebrated for high-speed omnidirectional mobility and punishing bosses.
